{{also|jakis}}
==Polish==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|pl|jakisi||Przemyśl|Rzeszów|Iwonicz-Zdrój|Podhale|Zakopane|Skawa|Zagórze}}

===Etymology===
{{ety|pl|:af|jaki|-ś<id:some-><ref:{{R:pl:Sławski|jakiś}}>|etydate=1534<ref:{{R:pl:SXVI|+|55500}}>|tree=+|text=+}} Compare {{cog|csb|jaczis}}, {{cog|szl|jakiś}}, and {{cog|zlw-slv|jakjysz}}.

===Pronunciation===
{{pl-pr|a=Pl-jakiś.ogg|mp=#}}

===Pronoun===
{{h|pl|pronoun}}

# [[some]]; {{ng|unspecified member of the category described by the following word}}
#: {{syn|pl|jaki|jeden|pewien}}
#: {{ux|pl|W ogrodzie widziałem '''jakieś''' zwierzę.|I saw '''some''' animal in the garden. ''(and I'm not sure what it was)''}}
#: {{ux|pl|Jeśli będziesz w sklepie, to kup '''jakąś''' herbatę.|If you visit a store, buy '''some''' tea. ''(any tea will do)''}}

===Particle===
{{h|pl|particle}}

# {{lb|pl|colloquial}} {{ng|used to express doubt on the usage of a term on the speaker's part}}; [[kinda]], [[sorta]]
#: {{uxi|pl|Ona jest '''jakaś''' niemiła.|She's '''kinda''' mean.}}
# {{lb|pl|colloquial}} {{ng|used to express doubt on the amount on the speaker's part}}; [[about]]
#: {{syn|pl|jaki|gdzieś}}
#: {{uxi|pl|Ma '''jakiś''' litr.|It has '''about''' a liter.}}

====Declension====
{{pl-decl-pronoun
|jakiś|jakaś|jakieś|jacyś|jakieś
|jakiegoś|jakiejś|jakiegoś|jakichś|jakichś
|jakiemuś|jakiejś|jakiemuś|jakimś|jakimś
|jakiegoś/jakiś|jakąś|jakieś|jakichś|jakieś
|jakimś|jakąś|jakimś|jakimiś|jakimiś
|jakimś|jakiejś|jakimś|jakichś|jakichś
}}
In the accusative, the form {{m|pl|jakiegoś}} is used for masculine personal and masculine animate nouns, while {{m|pl|jakiś}} is used for masculine inanimate nouns.
